messages:
Lina: heads-up: promotion is stalled in verify after a background cache-prune overlapped with prefetch. deploybot showing manifest 412s and index read locks.
Ravi: yup seeing it on the dashboard. small subset of manifests returning 412 during verify.
KB: logs snippet:
```
2026-04-02T11:02:05Z prune: started shard=13
2026-04-02T11:02:06Z index: delete /shard-13/manifest/sha256:ef12...
2026-04-02T11:02:06Z verify: read index for sha256:ef12... -> 412
2026-04-02T11:02:07Z deploybot: verify retry attempt=3 id=sha256:ef12...
2026-04-02T11:02:07Z deploybot: verify queue blocked waiting on index lock
```
ops-bot: promotion paused by deploybot. default retry/backoff active. pending verifies: 29.
Lina: change window closes in ~50m. Options: (A) force promote to last-known-good image (sha256:7788) or (B) run targeted shard-repair which may take >30m.
Ravi: last-known-good passed canary earlier today. missing today's tiny doc-change, acceptable.
KB: additional option C: temporarily reduce VERIFY_CONCURRENCY to 1 to drain queue; that should allow in-flight verifies to complete without hitting the index hotspot. This is quick but not a root fix.
Lina: prefer fastest safe path to preserve window. I'm leaning force-promote + follow-ups. Any objections? 90s.
Ravi: +1. we need a rollback plan documented in notes.
KB: +1. also recommend ephemeral change: set VERIFY_CONCURRENCY=1 if force-promote still blocked, then restore after. I'll prepare a runbook step.
Lina: executing manual promote: /promote --image sha256:7788 --by lina --reason "blocked verify after prune"
deploybot: promote request accepted. skipping prefetch. verify queued on runner-2.
deploybot: verify succeeded on runner-2 id=sha256:7788. rollout progressing.
deploybot: rollout finished. change-window preserved.
Lina: release notes line: "Pinned to last-known-good image due to artifact-index prune overlapping prefetch; follow-ups: pre-prune deploy quiesce, shard-repair automation, alert on verify-queue spikes."
Ravi: filing tickets: ART-821 (pre-prune quiesce), INFRA-130 (verify-queue alert), RELEASE-305 (post-release validation). Attaching logs.
KB: will add short runbook for VERIFY_CONCURRENCY mitigation.
Lina: thanks everyone. closing thread.
